+title: 'D207: the change stream of the transcript search index for Spotlight'
+---
+Decision D207 (i), Q68 and Q71 to Q73. Brief: `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/.briefs/search/acpa-brief.md`, change step 9.
+
+## Dependency
+
+^jex3g34 (the TranscriptSearchIndex). Do it after the update task of the index, because the stream reports its changes.
+
+## Change
+
+1. The index gives the host an `AsyncStream` of its changes:
+   - the turns of a session that it indexed: the session id, the turn index, the date, and the text of the chunks of the turn by kind;
+   - the sessions that it removed.
+2. `turns(of:)`: the same turns of one session, from its items.
+3. `allTurns()`: all turns, for a new Spotlight index.
+4. This package does not import CoreSpotlight. The app writes the items and applies the rule of Q71 (no tool output and no thoughts). Give each kind, so the app can apply the rule.
+
+## Tests
+
+- A turn of a session gives one change with its turns; a delete gives one removal.
+- `turns(of:)` and `allTurns()` give the same turns as the stream.
+- A second index instance (the app's `client/` folder) has its own stream. #d207 #search
\ No newline at end of file

--- original

@@ -1,6 +1,17 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7t1x37y660wwj9mxkd3hxzd
+  text: |-
+    Research (implement step):
+    - Each change of the catalog goes through `TranscriptSearchIndex.index(_:removing:)`: a history write and a fork (`TranscriptSearchApplier.indexHistory`), a delete (`.removal`), and the reconcile of a folder (`TranscriptSearchApplier.reconcile`). Thus the index emits the changes there, after `publishCatalog()`. The update queue of ^en1kt61 and the reconcile get the stream with no change of their own. `update(session:metadata:)` (rename, tags, recap, archive) changes only the session item, so it gives no turn change.
+    - Design: `TranscriptSearchTurn` (session id, turn, date = the first date of its chunks, the chunks of the turn as kind + text, in order) and `TranscriptSearchChange` (`.indexed(session:turns:)` with ALL turns of the session, `.removed(session:)`). A session whose chunk items did not change gives no change (the reconcile at launch gives the same items again for each session). The change reads the state of the session when it is emitted, so a change that a later change overtook (actor reentrancy) never gives old turns after new ones.
+    - Subscribers: `changes()` is nonisolated; each call makes its own `AsyncStream` in `TranscriptSearchChangeFeed` (a Mutex over the continuations). Policy: `.bufferingNewest(1024)`. The yield never waits, so a slow subscriber never blocks the index; a subscriber that falls behind by more than 1,024 changes loses the oldest ones (logged), and it can read `allTurns()` again.
+    - Chunk turns start at 0 (entries before the first prompt), a user message starts a new turn (FoundationModelsACP SessionSearchChunker).
+    - Files: the other agent (^f71bbpe) owns the AgentTranscriptSearcher file and the tool wiring; this card does not touch them.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-19T14:03:25.310963+00:00
